messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Argh! I hate being stood up 😭 kanti mina ngizobhebha nini

output.original_text: Argh! I hate being stood up 😭 kanti mina ngizobhebha nini
output.joy: I'm so thrilled to finally have plans, but being stood up is really disappointing! When will I get to enjoy that time?
output.sadness: Argh! I truly hate being stood up 😭 It's just so lonely wondering when I will be loved again.
output.fear: Argh! Being stood up terrifies me 😭 What if it keeps happening? When will I find someone who cares?
output.anger: Argh! Being stood up really infuriates me! 😭 When will I stop wasting my time?
output.surprise: Argh! I can’t believe I was stood up! 😭 When will I actually get to see some affection?
output.disgust: Argh! Being stood up is just so infuriating and gross! 😭 Seriously, when will I get a moment of respect?
